additions.distinctness_review: The 198 site, project, historical identity and source records contain no Stanton Springs, Morning Hornet, Baymare, Social Circle or Newton County match. County records distinguish Meta’s original 2018 Newton County campus and the 2021 three-county East Campus, both in Stanton Springs South.

locator.identity_review: OpenStreetMap names campus #2. The authority identifies the second campus as the three-county property and the Baymare lease as the eastern campus. The representative point also lies inside Morgan County’s mapped tract 4, identified as part of the East Campus in the filed property record.
locator.method: Project the named OpenStreetMap campus area to UTM zone 17N, take its interior area centroid, and transform the point to WGS 84.
locator.precision: Representative point for Meta’s second Stanton Springs campus on the eastern development property.
locator.uncertainty_reason: A campus area representative point supplies no positional accuracy for an individual project building.

additions.name: Meta Stanton Springs East Campus — rapid deployment expansion

status.summary: In its report for the quarter ending September 30, 2026, the joint development authority said Meta was continuing construction of its rapid deployment structures at Stanton Springs.

additions.successor_review: The authority confirms construction of the same second-campus structures in its Q3 2026 report. Subsequent material reviewed supplies no completed or operational milestone for these structures. Operator summaries covering both properties do not establish a change in this project.

additions.distinctness_review: The factory conversion is a separate project at lot 638-5. Its road address, original factory name and project aliases do not match any baseline row. The nearest listed site is LG Uplus Pyeongchon Mega Center, Anyang, 20.5 km away.

locator.identity_review: The contractor identifies parcel 638-5 in Seonggok-dong. The current national register links that lot to 79 Sinwon-ro 91beon-gil. The archival coordinate row has the same road code, building number, administrative district and postcode and identifies its use as industrial.
locator.method: Match the national lot-to-road-address register to the archived Ministry address record, transform from GRS80 UTM-K to WGS 84 and round to four decimal places.
locator.precision: Representative civic address point for the existing industrial property being converted.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The national address database does not give measured positional accuracy for this individual property.

additions.name: OUR DC Ansan — former Our Circuit factory conversion

status.summary: OUR DC reported that construction began on October 12, 2026, on the conversion of the former Our Circuit factory in Ansan into a commercial data center.

additions.successor_review: The developer reported the actual October 12 construction start. CJ’s earlier contract schedule is separate. The developer’s target for operations in the second half of 2027 remains a forecast.

additions.distinctness_review: Snapshot 198 contains TR7 at 1895 Williams Parkway, city address ID 1874230, site plan SP99-028.000. TR6 is a separately named IBX at 30 Bramtree Court, city address ID 1939010, site plan SP00-059.000. The two mapped buildings have disjoint footprints.

locator.identity_review: The operator and the city confirm the TR6 street address. The city’s primary address point falls inside the independently mapped and named TR6 building. The nearby TR7 building has a separate footprint and street address.
locator.method: Point on surface of named OpenStreetMap way 661951723, using its WGS84 exterior ring.
locator.precision: Building-level reference point for the TR6 property at 30 Bramtree Court.
locator.uncertainty_reason: OpenStreetMap gives no numerical survey accuracy for this footprint.
